voice: A huge old demon working as a shopkeeper, deep rasping male voice, smooth, unhurried and scrupulously polite, with menace under the courtesy, like an undertaker who enjoys his work.
reference_text: Ah, welcome back. Do come closer, I have kept the good scrolls aside. Every one of them leads somewhere you will not enjoy.

delivery.greet: Courteous and sinister, a slow rasping welcome.
delivery.buy: Pleased and silky, sealing a bargain.
delivery.craft: Intent and low, working something over with care.
delivery.goodbye: Dryly amused, seeing off a customer he expects never to see again.

greet: Back again. Still breathing, I see.
Welcome, welcome. Which door shall it be today?
Ah, my favourite customer. The last one was also my favourite.
buy: An excellent choice. Try not to die before the door closes.
Sold. No refunds, as you will appreciate.
That one has a lovely view. Briefly.
craft: There. Stronger. Whether you are is another matter.
Burned and bound. Mind the fingers.
broke: I do not deal in promises. Bring gold.
Your purse is lighter than your courage.
goodbye: Do leave your gold to someone. It is so often wasted.
Run along. The dark is waiting.
